Yeah you nailed it. Round 1 they took out the MDP, environment played Leaking room.
Round 2 villain played Consider the Price of Victory, Environment played Leaking Room. Round 3, Blade played a one-shot getting 15 cards into the trash… heroes would have lost no matter what at that point but the environment played Pillars of Hercules just to rub salt on the wound.

Dark Watch game wasn’t much better. There was only 1 Leaking Room, but the heroes ultimately lost on an out of turn Consider the price of victory played via Atlantian Font of Power the round before they would have flipped Blade.

The Nature vs. Dreamer game was really close. It actually came down to the Tooth Fairy incapacitating Scholar by forcing him to discard his last card… had he survived that attack, Nature would likely have won.
